title: Marketplace — Buy/Sell/Rent
description: 100% mocked, not wired to Firestore — reconciled: MarketplaceItemDoc.category is now taxonomy-backed (marketplace_categories), matching the app's real sale/rental/mixing/beats/services split. SCREEN-MAPPED 2026-08-12 (grounded Explore audit): one real, dashboard-wired browse screen (MarketplaceBetaScreen) with 6 category tabs including "Gear Rentals", an in-dialog item detail (not a separate screen), and a Saved/Favorites bookmarks tab — all backed by hardcoded lists, zero `marketplace_items` references anywhere. No create-listing, cart, checkout, or seller-messaging screens exist at all — confirmed absent by exhaustive grep, not just unaudited. MERGED 2026-08-13 (user call): the standalone "Equipment Rental" flow entry was folded in here rather than kept separate — rental was never anything more than one of this screen's own category tabs; see the equipment_rental key's former slot (order 9, now retired, not reassigned) for the original grounded finding this merge is based on.
